offers.title: Create: Launch an AI Influencer
offers.description: Design an original AI influencer persona and its first content: persona card, 3 on-brand photo concepts, an 8-second reel script, and a 7-day post plan.
offers.deliverable: Persona card, photo concepts with generation prompts, reel script and shot list, 7-day post plan
offers.prompt:
[stage:create] Create an AI influencer persona.
Niche: 
Target audience: 
Persona look and vibe (or reference image URLs): 
Voice and tone: 
Main platform: Instagram Reels
Goal (followers, leads, sales):

offers.title: Schedule: Plan & Auto-Publish Reels
offers.description: Build a posting calendar with recommended times and a publishing queue for your AI influencer's Instagram Reels, photos and carousels.
offers.deliverable: Posting calendar with times, publishing queue and checklist
offers.prompt:
[stage:schedule] Plan my posting schedule.
Persona (name or short description): 
Posts per week: 5
Date range: next 7 days
Timezone: 
Content to schedule (ideas or links): 
Auto-publish approved posts (yes/no): no

offers.title: Engage: Reply to Comments & DMs
offers.description: Triage comments and DMs, draft on-brand replies in your persona's voice, and flag conversations a human should handle. Nothing is sent without approval.
offers.deliverable: Ranked inbox, draft replies, escalation list
offers.prompt:
[stage:engage] Draft replies for my inbox.
Persona voice: 
Topics to avoid: 
Paste comments and DMs (one per line, with @username):

offers.title: Analyze: Performance & Next Content
offers.description: Turn your post metrics into a KPI summary, explain top and bottom performers, score your hooks, and plan next week's content.
offers.deliverable: KPI report, top/bottom posts, hook scorecard, next week's plan
offers.prompt:
[stage:analyze] Analyze my content performance.
Persona: 
Period: last 7 days
Goal metric (reach, followers, saves, leads): 
Paste post metrics (date, format, hook, views, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves, avg watch time):

examples: Launch a faceless fitness-coach AI influencer
